summary: @servicetitan/skeleton preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes bundled 727KB obfuscated payload
details: Package @servicetitan/skeleton@9.2.6 declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13) from GitHub releases, extracts and chmods it, and then invokes it via execFileSync on a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. If a system `bun` is already available, it is used directly. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated blob using string-array rotation (`WV8StW`) and hex-named identifiers with a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header — a packed executable whose behavior is not statically inspectable. The package is advertised as a UI skeleton library, a purpose that does not require an alternate JavaScript runtime or an obfuscated bootstrapper. Fetching a second runtime specifically to run a bundled opaque payload on `npm install` evades Node-based scanners and results in installer-side code execution of unreviewable content.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
